question: What happens when the previously stated yantra procedure is performed in reverse on lead bronze and similar materials?
premises: The verse names lead bronze and similar substances.
It says the previously stated rite is done in reverse.
Reverse performance is contrasted with proper performance.
inference: Improper reverse construction on such materials is condemned or ineffective.
uncertainties: Whether this means curse or mere invalidity is not fully explicit.
plain_english: When the stated rite is done in reverse on lead, bronze, and similar materials, it is an opposite or improper act.
